verdict.rationale: Granola's built-in Chat assistant can be asked to complete post-meeting tasks: drafting and sending follow-up emails and Slack messages, and creating Google Calendar events, with a review step before anything is sent. It also answers questions across meetings, and favourite prompts can be saved as one-click recipes. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Chat's task execution, and evidence of delegation beyond the few documented actions (email, Slack, calendar).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Granola Chat can help you complete the work that comes after a meeting, without switching between your notes and other apps.
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
you can save your favorite prompts as recipes and run them with a single click.
